set.n: North Henderson bank loot in Richard Garrett's barn, sec 30 (found 1913)
set.pl: Richard Garrett 196.60, N half sec 30 T13N R1W (North Henderson Twp, Mercer Co), 1914 Standard atlas; about 2 mi NE of Alexis and 3-4 mi W of North Henderson.
pinev: 1914 Standard Atlas of Mercer & Henderson Cos, North Henderson Twp plate: 'Richard Garrett 196.60' in the N half of sec 30 T13N R1W; a second Garrett 53.95 in the SW corner of sec 31 by the CB&Q at the Warren Co line. Sec 30 fits both 1913 papers (2.5 mi NE of Alexis; 4 mi W of North Henderson). BLM PLSS sec 30 = 41.0785-41.0933, -90.5500 to -90.5331.
No house or barn mark visible at the zoom read, so the farmstead itself is not fixed. The papers spell the name Garnett; the atlas and the Graphic-Reporter have Garrett.
set.t: FOUND: the barn cache was emptied in 1913. The farm is placed; the barn site is not. Access: private.
